summary: Verified Website Builder image sections + WebP photo optimization. Backend photo endpoint returns webp with Accept:image/webp and honors ?w= resize. New fields team_photo_id/why_photo_id/band_photo_id persist via PUT/GET /api/website. Public site /sitio/uni2-marketing-agency?preview=1 renders About collage, Feature block (#feature with CTA), and CTA band with zero broken images. Editor Photos tab exposes all three PhotoField pickers; Sections tab has feature+band toggles ON by default and persist across reloads. Regression: content edit + save works.

minor.issue: New fields (team_photo_id/why_photo_id/band_photo_id) are omitted from response when unset; only appear after being written. Not strictly a bug (fields default effectively to empty) but frontend consumers must handle absence. Consider always returning them with empty-string defaults for consistency.

action_items: (Optional) Backend: always include team_photo_id/why_photo_id/band_photo_id (empty string) in GET /api/website response for shape stability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large; _optimize_image + public photo endpoint are fine but the file continues to grow — consider extracting a media/optimization module.
Public photo endpoint properly returns image/webp only when Accept header includes webp; verified. No 500s observed.
PhotoField reuse in WebsiteEditor.js is clean with clear data-testids (website-team-*, website-why-photo-*, website-band-*).
seed_data_creation: None. why_photo_id was temporarily set to 025520a3-... then removed. Sections feature/band both restored to ON at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend photo endpoint: no Accept header -> image/jpeg; with Accept:image/webp -> image/webp. ?w= downscales (w=600 < w=1600 in bytes). LARGE_PHOTO_ID 397d8092-92f4-4eaa-9e18-8c4043a87b9d verified. Editor uses /pagina-web route (not /website). Sections toggle testids: website-section-feature, website-section-band (Radix Switch; data-state=checked/unchecked).
